## Checklist (docs/standards.md, Definition of Done)

- [ ] Each new or changed document has Owner, Status and Review by in its header
- [ ] Links resolve inside the repository
- [ ] Terms follow docs/glossary.md; names follow docs/naming-conventions.md
- [ ] No secret, token, key or connection string in any file (use `<REDACTED>`)
- [ ] Security review trigger checked (governance/SECURITY_GOVERNANCE.md). If yes: threat model entry added
- [ ] Rollback step stated (infrastructure and operations changes)
- [ ] Status of every ADR changed by this PR is set by the owner, not by an agent
